title: WordPress como Second Brain v2: O Operating System do One-Person Business
description: **Agenda / Schedule** * 18:45 - Chegada / Doors open * 19:00 - Início da apresentação / Talk starts * 20:00 - Jantar (opcional) / Dinner (optional) @ Valenciana, Campolide ────────────────────────────── Na primeira edição desta palestra, no Meetup WordPress do Porto, o António Almeida (AJOSCOA) mostrou como o WordPress pode ser a base de um Second Brain alimentado por Markdown. Desde então, o sistema evoluiu. Nesta sessão, vai-nos mostrar a versão 2 em produção: 12 módulos interligados no Córtex Corporativo - Contacts, Projects, Offerings, Subscriptions, Tasks, Agents, Processes, Notes, Transactions, Accounts, Proposals e Profile. A novidade está nas camadas que tornaram o sistema verdadeiramente agentico: integração MCP para Claude, um bot Telegram para captura de dados no momento, uma extensão Chrome que converte qualquer página em Markdown e a alimenta diretamente ao sistema, e a adoção do Open Knowledge Format (OKF), o novo standard aberto da Google para representação de conhecimento interoperável entre agentes de IA. O momento mais forte desta sessão será ao vivo: criar uma tarefa no Second Brain que dispara um agente, executa um clone de uma instalação WordPress, fecha a tarefa e atualiza automaticamente os dados de acesso no Projeto. ────────────────────────────── At the first edition of this talk, held at the Porto WordPress Meetup, António Almeida (AJOSCOA) demonstrated how WordPress can serve as the foundation of a Second Brain powered by Markdown. Since then, the system has evolved. In this session, he will present version 2 running in production: 12 interconnected modules within the Corporate Cortex — Contacts, Projects, Offerings, Subscriptions, Tasks, Agents, Processes, Notes, Transactions, Accounts, Proposals, and Profile. The major innovation lies in the layers that have made the system truly agentic: MCP integration for Claude, a Telegram bot for capturing information in real time, a Chrome extension that converts any webpage into Markdown and feeds it directly into the system, and the adoption of the Open Knowledge Format (OKF), Google’s new open standard for interoperable knowledge representation between AI agents. The highlight of the session will be a live demonstration: creating a task in the Second Brain that triggers an agent, executes a clone of a WordPress installation, closes the task, and automatically updates the project’s access credentials.

description: Longevity, LEV & Financial Independence: Planning for a Longer Life What happens to financial independence and retirement planning if we live much longer, healthier lives than previous generations? In this open discussion, we’ll explore the connection between longevity, healthspan, and FIRE/financial independence. We’ll look at both sides of the topic: The practical side of longevity today * Exercise, strength, VO₂ max, sleep, nutrition, prevention, biomarkers, and healthcare habits * How healthspan affects freedom, work, family, travel, and quality of life * Why health can be seen as part of your financial independence plan The speculative but important side * LEV: Longevity Escape Velocity, the idea that medical progress may eventually extend healthy lifespan faster than we age * What longer lifespans could mean for withdrawal rates, investment horizons, risk, inflation, healthcare costs, and life planning * Whether traditional retirement assumptions still make sense if “retirement” could last 50, 60, 70+ years, or longer This will not be a formal lecture or medical/financial advice. The goal is to have an open conversation with questions, different perspectives, and practical ideas. Some questions we may discuss: * If you expected to live much longer, would you invest differently? * Does the 4% rule make sense for very early retirement or very long lives? * Should FIRE plans aim to preserve capital indefinitely instead of slowly spending it down? * How much should we invest in health now to increase future freedom? * What can we realistically do today to improve our odds of living longer and better? * How do purpose, relationships, curiosity, and life design change if life becomes much longer? This event is for anyone interested in investing, FIRE, longevity, biohacking, healthspan, future medicine, or simply designing a better long-term life. 📋 Important Note This is a strictly non-commercial meetup. Nothing will be sold, and nothing shared should be considered financial advice.
